findings: The two SHA-distinct DOC variants have identical deterministic extracted text (5,543 characters each after extraction; whitespace-normalized text matches exactly).
The FY2020 and FY2021 copies are binary-exact duplicates of each other.
The FY2022/AAP Forms/EEO-folder copies share another binary SHA but are text-identical to the FY2020/2021 variant.
Treat all copies as one historical form family for searchable knowledge while retaining both binary SHA identities for provenance.
currentness: The form family is historical evidence and is not confirmed as the current 2026 harassment complaint form. The current 2025 handbook supplies reporting channels but the ingested sources do not explicitly adopt this form.
privacy_rule: Blank form text is safe. Completed complaint forms and any allegation/evidence/interview content are restricted case records.
